answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust edge, while temporal decay applies an exponential half-life to accumulated reputation. EigenTrust factorization therefore rewards identities that sustain honest, mutually confirmed service; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, and coordinated low-history edges cannot amplify it. Only a verified score delta transferred across a trusted bridge can raise standing toward summit-level consensus, so it cannot pass consensus immediately.
